question: Should full-mode plugins be allowed to reset gateway sessions through a public late-callable SDK method, and what call-time gate must protect that authority?
rationale: This changes the plugin trust boundary and session-state mutation surface; code review can identify the missing gate, but maintainers need to confirm the permanent public SDK contract before merge.

options.title: Gate reset authority before merge
options.body: Add global-side-effect and active-registry checks before invoking reset, cover stale/disabled/non-active plugin closures, then re-review the public API shape.

options.title: Accept the new plugin authority
options.body: Maintainers can explicitly accept that full-mode plugins may rotate sessions through this method, but should still document the trust model and proof expectations.

options.title: Pause the SDK surface
options.body: If plugin-driven session rotation is not the desired contract, pause or close this branch and replace it with a narrower hook or owner-specific design.

recommendation.title: Gate reset authority before merge
recommendation.body: Add global-side-effect and active-registry checks before invoking reset, cover stale/disabled/non-active plugin closures, then re-review the public API shape.

likelyOwner.reason: Most closely tied to recent plugin SDK and registry side-effect gate work that decides the permanent API boundary.
